_note: npm packages are discovered live from npm_maintainer and each is re-checked against the registry's maintainer list. PyPI has no public per-user listing API, so new PyPI packages are added here by hand; the gate then verifies each one both EXISTS and is OWNED (author/homepage/project_urls must match an ownership marker). 'apriori' was removed 2026-09-04: pypi.org/project/apriori belongs to LorenzoPiu, not to this account.
